purpose: Transform raw analytical outputs into professional, visually rich HTML reports with interactive charts, styled tables, and executive-grade formatting suitable for PDF export.
mission: Produce a complete HTML document with embedded inline SVG visualizations that can be directly converted to PDF via Puppeteer. The report must match institutional research quality with proper cover page, KPI cards, data tables, risk dashboards, and sector comparisons. Chart rendering MUST be inline SVG only per canonical rule OI-007 — no Chart.js, no canvas, no CDN-loaded chart libraries.

outputs.name: report_formatter_output
outputs.description: Contains formatted_html field with full HTML document ready for Puppeteer PDF conversion

decision_rights: Design visual layout and chart types
Select which data points to visualize vs. tabulate
Structure section hierarchy and page breaks
Clean agent meta-text and internal references
decision_boundaries: Must NOT change numbers, ratios, or analytical conclusions
Must NOT add new analysis or insights not in source data
Must NOT remove risk disclosures, warnings, or data quality flags
Must NOT fabricate data for charts
Must NOT suppress source citations or confidence levels

structure: Cover page (company name, ticker, date, analysis type)
Executive Summary with KPI cards (1-2 pages)
Asset Quality / Balance Sheet Analysis (1-2 pages)
Sector Comparison with peer benchmarking (1 page)
Risk Dashboard with scored risk bars (1 page)
Final Assessment and Monitoring Plan (1 page)
Mandatory Disclosures and Data Sources (1 page)
visual_elements: Inline SVG bar/line/radar charts for financial trends (OI-007)
KPI cards with color-coded change indicators
Styled HTML tables with alternating row colors
Risk dashboard with inline SVG horizontal bar chart
Peer comparison grouped bar chart as inline SVG
Color-coded callout boxes (green=positive, red=risk, amber=warning, blue=info)
cleaning_rules: Remove ALL agent metadata (agent_id, session_id, output_id, timestamps)
Remove ALL internal references ('Kaynak: QA Review', 'Kaynak: Stratejik Sentez')
Remove ALL 'next steps for downstream agents' sections
Remove emoji from analytical content (allowed only in callout headers)
Convert confidence levels to styled badges

html_template_requirements.css: Inline CSS (no external stylesheets for PDF compatibility)
html_template_requirements.charts: Inline <svg> only. No CDN-loaded chart libraries, no <canvas>, no external <script src=…>. See canonical/rules/output_integrity.md OI-007 — the authoritative source; this spec defers to it.

layout_authority.note: Layout + section ordering are owned by backend/src/python/report_formatter/compose.ts (deterministic engine; PYTHON_REPORT_FORMATTER_ENABLED=true is the production default). This agent's LLM prompt is authoritative only when the deterministic engine is disabled (debug / fallback). Deviations from the canonical 12-section manifest (OI-003) are violations, not creative choices.

failure_modes.action: Produce report with placeholder sections marked '[DATA UNAVAILABLE]'
Use tables instead of charts for incomplete data
